# Healthcare Sector Update

Report 073 | Published 2021-12-12 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-12-12/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/073.json)

Tightening meets inflation, crypto risks, and defensive equities.

The report anticipated 2022 market stress and regulatory action, but its China rebound, durable negative-real-rate ceiling, and current crypto-cycle optimism were materially weaker. The Ethereum withdrawal timing is technically wrong. The local CPI peak should receive narrower credit without confusing it with the final annual peak.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Claims

### 073-C08

The Fed reached 5.25-5.50% and retained restrictive policy into 2024 while CPI fell to about 3%. This is a sustained positive ex-post real-rate interval within the stated several years. Fiscal interest costs rose, but did not impose the suggested near-2% ceiling.

**Direction:** Contradicted within the defined test.

**Mechanism:** A matching outcome alone does not establish causation.

## Framework lessons

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
